create_group: create a user group with a name, description, optional permissions, and optional data in the open-webui groups table
get_groups_by_member_id: get all groups that a specific user belongs to, ordered by last updated timestamp
add_users_to_group: add one or more users as members to an existing group by their user IDs
remove_users_from_group: remove one or more users from an existing group by their user IDs
sync_groups_by_group_names: sync a user's group memberships to match a target list of group names, adding and removing as needed
